svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Finite-prime-support classification matrix across representative radices
svg.desc: Matrix with eight rows of prime supports (empty set, {2}, {3}, {5}, {2, 3}, {2, 5}, {3, 5}, {2, 3, 5}) and seven columns of radices (2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 15, 30). Cells labelled 0 are tinted aqua (normal); cells labelled 1 are tinted orange (maximal discrepancy). A 1 appears exactly when every prime of the support divides the radix: the whole empty-support row, the cells of {2} under radices 2, 6, 10 and 30, and the whole radix-30 column.
svg.text: Finite prime supports: normal or maximally discrepant
Limit of the interval discrepancy of X = Σ 1/(mˢ bᵐ) over m with all prime factors in P
